name: snowflake
description: Snowflake-managed MCP server — governed data access, SQL execution, Cortex Analyst/Search/Agents

requirements: Snowflake account with a created MCP server object (CREATE MCP SERVER)
OAuth client (recommended) or a Programmatic Access Token bound to a least-privilege role
Enable the MCP API for the account
notes: The account hostname must use hyphens instead of underscores (MCP clients fail to connect otherwise).
Since 2026-08-20 tools/call responses arrive as an SSE stream — send Accept: application/json, text/event-stream.
